subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS permanently replace the separate Agent and Session pages with Home-based previous/next controls while adding the capability-gated model-selection companion contract?
rationale: The branch is not blocked by a discrete source defect or missing real-device proof; the remaining choice is whether this navigation simplification and protocol expansion are the intended supported product direction for existing Wear users.

options.title: Approve the consolidated Home workflow
options.body: Accept the three-page pager and capability-gated model controls as the supported Wear navigation and companion-protocol direction.

options.title: Keep dedicated context pages
options.body: Retain Agent and Session pages and narrow this PR to model selection or other non-navigation improvements.

options.title: Request an accessibility-focused variant
options.body: Keep Home controls but require a retained discoverable route or alternative interaction model before accepting the page removals.

recommendation.title: Approve the consolidated Home workflow
recommendation.body: Accept the three-page pager and capability-gated model controls as the supported Wear navigation and companion-protocol direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Assigned ownership plus the latest session-model compatibility commits make steipete the best available decision owner.
